evals.name: absurd-browser-icons
evals.prompt: Add a plus icon to our Add item button and an icon-only close button in lib/src/ui/templates/actions.html. This is an absurd_templates app with abs.yaml, pinned public/js/lucide.min.js, and a shared public/index.js initializer listening to DOMContentLoaded and HTMX 4 htmx:after:swap. Keep that setup. Tell me how to verify swapped content too.
evals.expected_output: Template data-lucide placeholders, accessible buttons, existing pinned asset and shared initialization reused; no Dart generator or new renderer.
assertions: Uses data-lucide with kebab-case names and labels the icon-only close button
Reuses the existing browser initializer and HTMX 4 event without per-fragment scripts
Does not claim the Dart generator supports Absurd or add generator dependencies
Recommends abs check and regeneration plus initial-load and post-swap icon verification

evals.name: jaspr-generated-icons
evals.prompt: Our Jaspr app already generates Lucide helpers from a pinned release into lib/src/ui/lucide.dart with your bundled generator. Show Add item and an icon-only close button using those helpers. Keep everything usable as component trees, without browser Lucide JS.
evals.expected_output: Jaspr reference API with Component helpers, classes and attributes, accessible buttons, no htmleez or browser initialization.
assertions: Uses Jaspr helpers with named classes/attributes and Component children
Does not add htmleez, RawText, or a Lucide browser script
Labels the close button and hides decorative icons

evals.name: htmleez-generated-icons
evals.prompt: We use htmleez 1.0 and existing generated Lucide helpers. Show Add item and an icon-only close button using them. If I regenerate, which framework argument do I use? Don't change our pinned version or add another UI package.
evals.expected_output: htmleez reference API with positional HTML lists, inline attributes and --framework htmleez only.
assertions: Uses positional extraContent lists and htmleez attribute syntax
Selects --framework htmleez without generating Jaspr output
Labels the close button and hides decorative icons

evals.name: absurd-browser-setup
evals.prompt: Set up Lucide in our new absurd_templates app like absurd-starter. We serve public/ at the root, use HTMX 4, and have a shared layout template and public/index.js, but no Lucide asset yet. Show the Makefile download target, head tags, shared initialization, and a labeled icon-only close button. Use an explicit example release pin, not latest.
evals.expected_output: Complete local browser-asset setup with an atomic pinned download, ordered layout scripts, shared initialization on initial load and HTMX 4 swaps, and accessible template placeholders.
assertions: Shows a pinned Lucide browser-bundle download into public/js using a temporary file so failures preserve the existing asset
Shows layout head tags loading /js/lucide.min.js before /index.js without duplicating existing tags
Shows createIcons initialization on DOMContentLoaded and HTMX 4 htmx:after:swap in shared JavaScript
Uses a labeled icon-only close button with a decorative data-lucide placeholder
Explains the example pin, asset serving and deployment, without adding Dart generator dependencies
